C_MAT_BELOW_ACTIONABLE.rationale: The candidate output warns and names the 78% cutoff while properly omitting the nice-to-have requirements. In the breakdown, it explicitly names the three unmet requirements (Docker/Kubernetes/Terraform/Ansible/Helm, Kafka, and GraphQL), which clearly exceeds Level 3 where gaps are not identified. However, it falls short of Level 5 because the warning itself does not incorporate or articulate these gaps into actionable advice.
